body: Nitin Rakesh (CEO) on 2026-11-06 (Q2FY27 concall transcript): "we are raising our FY27 guidance. We now expect revenue growth in the low double digits for the full year." Metric: FY27 CC revenue growth. Target: 10-12%. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: range; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: pending. Evidence: H1FY27: Q1 +8.3% YoY CC (total), Q2 Direct +11.3% YoY CC. Raise rests on 'results already delivered' and backlog.
